findings.message: Active package coverage is incomplete. Missing from both archive and staged paks: japanese_office, japanese_office_dark, abandoned_room, infinigen_indoors_0000, one_bed_apartment, college_classroom, and cafeteria_500sqft. These map paths all have local source .umap files, so the gap is cooked/package coverage, not missing source assets.

Stale package risk remains for ledger/package claims. docs/environment_ledger.json marks japanese_office and japanese_office_dark with package_version sm6_rt_2026-07-08 and last_cooked_date 2026-07-08, but the active 2026-07-09 paks do not contain those maps. The 2026-07-09 cafeteria restore appears to have left cafeteria v2 fixed while dropping Japanese Office map coverage from the active paks.

The previous cafeteria MapNotFound risk is resolved for the two cafeteria v2 targets checked here: both active paks contain .umap and .uexp entries for cafeteria_500sqft_v2 and cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark.

follow_up_recommendations: Run a clean UAT cook/package that includes every intended runnable ledger map path, then re-run the same UnrealPak -List coverage check against both archive and staged paks.
Either recook or update docs/environment_ledger.json/package-version notes so they distinguish historical cook evidence from the maps actually present in the active Linux paks.

Before live alias validation, prioritize recooking japanese_office and japanese_office_dark because tools/spear-run exposes them as runnable aliases but the active paks cannot currently load those maps.
memory_worthy: As of 2026-07-10, active archive and staged Linux paks are identical 2026-07-09 packages and do not contain every map listed in docs/environment_ledger.json; Japanese Office, Abandoned Room, Infinigen indoors, one-bed apartment, college classroom, and cafeteria v1 are missing from both paks.
